component.name: rmMeta
component.summary: Remove hidden metadata from photos and documents

description.p: Files record more about you than you put in them. Cameras and phones write down where a picture was taken, which camera took it and when. Office applications add the author's name, the company, how many times the document was saved and how long it was open. All of it travels with the file when you send it.
rmMeta shows you what is in a file before it touches anything, then takes it out. Images are never re-encoded, so a cleaned photo is pixel for pixel the one you started with.

ul.li: JPEG — Exif, GPS coordinates, camera serial numbers, maker notes, XMP, IPTC, comments and the embedded thumbnail
PNG, GIF and WebP — text chunks, comments, embedded Exif and XMP
TIFF and camera RAW — location, serial numbers, maker notes and timestamps, without disturbing the image data
HEIC, HEIF and AVIF — the Exif and XMP payloads
SVG — the RDF metadata block and the drawing program's own traces
Word, Excel and PowerPoint 97-2003 files — the summary property streams
PDF — the information dictionary, XMP, the file identifier, comment authors, and any earlier revisions the file was still carrying
Word, Excel and PowerPoint files — author, company, revision count and editing times
OpenDocument text, spreadsheets and presentations — the same, plus the software that wrote them

description.p: Everything happens on your own computer. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Maker notes in RAW files are kept by default, with a menu option to remove them; Clean Automatically mode cleans dropped files straight away; cleaned rows keep their list of what was removed

Fixes: PDF form field names kept; SVG stays well-formed; embedded pictures cleaned in documents, PDFs and SVGs; safer TIFF/RAW sub-directories; ORF and RW2; legacy Office keeps titles and blanks Excel/PowerPoint user names; Flatpak copies go to a chosen folder
Stronger dissolve in the app icon.
Added GIF, WebP, TIFF and camera RAW, HEIC/HEIF/AVIF, SVG, and legacy Office (.doc/.xls/.ppt) support.
